dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Are you a witness? Did you see the accident?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. ər juː ə ˈwɪtnəs? dɪd juː ˈsiː ði ˈæksɪdənt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. I was waiting at the crosswalk when it happened.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈdɪd. aɪ wʌz ˈweɪtɪŋ ət ðə ˈkrɔːswɔːk wɛn ɪt ˈhæpənd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A motorcycle taxi was going very fast, and it hit a car.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈmoʊtərsaɪkəl ˌtæksi wʌz ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈvɛri ˈfæst, ənd ɪt ˈhɪt ə ˈkɑːr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it wasn't. It was waiting at the traffic light.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt ˈwʌzənt. ɪt wʌz ˈweɪtɪŋ ət ðə ˈtræfɪk ˌlaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it was. But the motorcycle didn't stop.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪt ˈwʌz. bʌt ðə ˈmoʊtərsaɪkəl ˈdɪdənt ˈstɑːp.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The driver hurt his arm, but his passenger was OK.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈdraɪvər ˈhɜːrt hɪz ˈɑːrm, bʌt hɪz ˈpæsɪndʒər wʌz oʊˈkeɪ.
